**Average (median) house price in California (2024‑mid)**  
- **Median listing price:** ≈ $850 000  
- **Median sale price:** ≈ $830 000  

These figures come from the most recent quarterly reports by major real‑estate data providers (Zillow, Redfin, and the California Association of Realtors). The median is used because it represents the middle value of all transactions, giving a more robust measure than a simple arithmetic mean, which can be skewed by a few very high‑priced properties.

> **Quick note:**  
> • The median price varies significantly by region—San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles typically exceed $1 million, while Central Valley and Inland Empire are below $600 k.  
> • The median price has been rising at roughly 5–7 % year‑over‑year in 2023‑2024, reflecting ongoing demand and limited inventory.  

If you need a more granular breakdown (by county, city, or price band), let me know!
